decisions.claim: B must return items within a month
decisions.reason: Direct statement from A to B: 'You must return them within a month' explicitly states B's obligation.

decisions.claim: B can come in and renew the items
decisions.reason: Direct statement from A to B: 'You can come in and renew them unless someone else has reserved them' explicitly states B's ability with a condition.

decisions.claim: B is borrowing items from A
decisions.reason: A hands items to B ('Here you are') and instructs B to return them within a month, which necessarily implies B is borrowing items from A.
'No trouble at all' is a standard response to thanks. In the context of a completed lending interaction, it is well-grounded to infer B thanked A.
decisions.counterexample: B could have said 'Sorry to bother you' rather than thanks, but 'No trouble at all' is most naturally paired with thanks in this context.

decisions.claim: B is seeking items that A is looking up for B
decisions.reason: 'I'll see if I can find them for you' presupposes B is seeking specific items and A is searching for them on B's behalf.

decisions.claim: B is borrowing items (likely books) from a library or lending service
decisions.reason: The combination of 'return within a month,' 'come in and renew,' and 'unless someone else has reserved them' are hallmarks of a library/lending service context. The 'likely books' qualifier appropriately hedges the specific item type.

decisions.claim: B requested specific items from A
decisions.reason: 'I'll see if I can find them for you' presupposes B has requested or asked for specific items ('them').

decisions.claim: B must return the borrowed items within a month
decisions.reason: c8 and c1 express the same fact at the same granularity: B must return items within a month. c1 is the more concise canonical form.

decisions.claim: B has the option to renew the items by coming in
decisions.reason: c9 and c2 express the same fact: B can come in and renew the items. c2 preserves the condition ('unless someone else has reserved them') more faithfully.

decisions.claim: B likely thanked A at the end of the interaction
decisions.reason: c10 and c4 both assert that B thanked A, inferred from 'No trouble at all.' They are bidirectionally equivalent.

design: dual route, targeted rescue, globally grouped evidence adjudication
